scoring_method.price_method: Lowest eligible bid divided by the proposal bid, multiplied by 100.
scoring_method.note: Component scores for experience, timeline, warranty, and team/approach use an explicitly defined evaluator rubric. These are proposed design scores, not scores supplied by the assessment.
